chain_words.nuance: has the power or means to do something
has the ability and is fairly good at it
has learned and practised a skill well
has a natural gift for something

explanation: These words all describe ability, from simply being able to do something to having an exceptional natural gift.

usage_notes.difference: 'Skilled' means you have learned and practised a skill well; 'talented' suggests a natural ability that makes the skill come easily.
